The government expressed specific concern about preventing uncertainties that could arise from generally worded bill of rights-style declarations.
***
Turnbull described the review as a timely expert stocktake intended to inform any necessary legislative reforms. He affirmed that Ruddock was the appropriate choice to conduct this review, citing his previous experience serving as Australia's special envoy for human rights.
